text: {"features":[{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The degree to which spelling, grammar, and surface-level correctness support rather than distract from the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Numerous conspicuous spelling or typing errors appear throughout and noticeably undermine credibility."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Repeated errors are easy to spot across the letter, though the overall meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few minor errors or awkward phrasings appear, but they do not materially disrupt reading."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The prose is clean and professional, with at most an isolated slip."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is essentially error-free and reads as carefully proofread."}]},{"name":"Narrative cohesion","description":"How well the letter organizes its points into a clear, persuasive flow instead of a disconnected list of claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads as a loose sequence of assertions with weak transitions and no clear argumentative arc."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic structure, but sections feel choppy, repetitive, or only partly connected."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has a clear beginning, middle, and end, though the case for fit is only moderately developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter connects motivation, experience, and fit in a well-ordered and persuasive progression."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers a memorable, tightly integrated story in which each paragraph advances the overall case."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How clearly the letter explains why the applicant wants this specific job rather than a generic software role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little reason for applying beyond broad interest in software or security."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows general enthusiasm for backend or security work but only weakly ties that interest to this opening."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter offers a plausible reason for applying and connects it to one notable aspect of the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly explains why this mix of security, automation, and infrastructure is attractive to the applicant."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes a compelling, individualized case for why this precise role fits the applicant's trajectory and priorities."}]},{"name":"Team-mandate understanding","description":"How accurately and specifically the letter reflects the posted responsibilities of this information security engineering team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter stays generic about security and software and shows little awareness of the team's actual responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references the team at a high level but misses most of the role's specific work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter correctly recognizes one or two major elements such as vulnerability response, secure development, or AI-enabled tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid understanding by connecting several responsibilities such as triage automation, lifecycle security, and developer assistance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates nuanced understanding of the charter through specific references to areas like variant analysis, proactive vulnerability handling, agentic tooling, or organization-wide security enablement."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How strongly the letter values building shared infrastructure whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention foundational systems, shared tooling, or organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter gestures at scale or impact but does not explain why central infrastructure work is attractive."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter expresses general interest in broad impact or foundational systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values building infrastructure whose benefits are inherited across teams or products."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes platform leverage a defining motivation, emphasizing multiplier effects or capacity expansion across the organization."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How clearly the letter frames security tooling as a way to help developers succeed through secure defaults and lower-friction workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not discuss developers as users of security tooling or defaults."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions helping others only vaguely, without connecting security work to developer experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states an interest in making secure behavior easier or more routine for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly emphasizes low-friction tooling, proactive help, or reduced toil for developer teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes developer enablement central, stressing secure-by-default systems and practical respect for the engineers who rely on them."}]},{"name":"Security collaboration readiness","description":"How well the letter shows readiness to work closely with security specialists or other stakeholders rather than operating in isolation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no signal of collaborating with security specialists or user teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter uses only generic teamwork language with no role-relevant partnership detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter indicates openness to working with security engineers or learning from domain experts."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear comfort partnering closely with specialists or end users to shape tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes cross-functional security partnership a clear strength, showing that close collaboration is central to how the applicant builds effective systems."}]},{"name":"Production experience depth","description":"The depth of hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes only limited qualifying experience, typically around 3 years with responsibility for about 2 production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows modest production experience, such as around 3 years with several launches or around 5 years with narrow service breadth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid mid-career depth, typically around 5 years with repeated ownership across multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial production depth, such as around 5 years with broad service delivery or around 7 years with several services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows extensive hands-on depth, typically around 7 years with repeated testing, maintenance, and launch responsibility across many production services."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys concern for correctness, maintainability, failure modes, and long-term operability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter centers mainly on features or credentials and gives no sign of maintenance or operational care."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions testing or maintenance only in a resume-like way, without expressing any reliability perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some appreciation for inherited systems, correctness, or operability."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values maintainability, correctness, or quiet dependable behavior as an engineering principle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes long-term stewardship central, showing mature thinking about failure modes, inherited systems, and software others can trust."}]},{"name":"Go fluency","description":"How strong and role-relevant the letter's evidence is that Go is a core language for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go only incidentally as one language among several, with no indication of depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter indicates professional Go use but does not make it clear that Go is a current strength."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that Go is a principal, primary, or daily working language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter ties strong Go usage to backend services, infrastructure, or systems work similar to this role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Go a standout strength through specific backend ownership or public-facing artifacts such as libraries, services, or control infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Python fluency","description":"How strong and role-relevant the letter's evidence is that the applicant can build the Python components this role requires.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter omits Python or mentions it only incidentally."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter signals some Python exposure but gives no clear tasks or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes regular Python use for scripts, tooling, automation, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong Python ownership in automation, analysis, service prototypes, or production services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes Python a major strength tied directly to high-leverage automation or agent implementations."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic problem solving","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical strength with data structures, algorithms, and performance-minded design.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no direct evidence of algorithmic or data-structure skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims strength in the area but leaves it unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter includes one believable example of improving a system through a better structure or algorithm."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter uses a concrete example to show algorithmic thinking as a recurring part of systems design."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents algorithmic problem solving as a standout capability through highly credible examples of major bottleneck removal, redesign, or simplification."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"The extent of direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter says nothing about automating security workflows."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter speaks generally about wanting to reduce security toil but gives no direct experience doing so."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions relevant queue or report automation but gives only limited detail on what changed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly describes building automation for vulnerability handling, such as classification, routing, deduplication, or prioritization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong end-to-end ownership of vulnerability workflow automation and makes the outcome sound materially transformative to a team's process."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"The extent of direct experience assessing systems for security issues and validating fixes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention performing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter implies some security exposure but not actual assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states assessment or review experience in general terms but with limited method or scope."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete assessment practices such as threat modeling, attack-surface mapping, code review, or remediation validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents substantial hands-on assessment experience as a meaningful part of the applicant's engineering judgment."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"The extent of direct experience designing systems that combine agents with surrounding infrastructure, supervision, or controls.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention agentic systems or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references AI or automation in a way that hints at agents but provides no architecture detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states experience building agentic tooling or pipelines at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes clear architectural ownership, such as Python agents paired with Go services, constraints, supervision, or audit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep, role-relevant agentic systems design with explicit attention to permissions, bounded execution, orchestration, or safety controls."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"How strong the letter's evidence is that the applicant has shipped AI features responsibly in real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI interest or exposure without shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states direct experience building or shipping AI-backed features."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful production AI experience with attention to reliability, evaluation, or hardening."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents AI as a strong professional capability through concrete production deployments and clear understanding of operational failure modes."}]},{"name":"Claim substantiation","description":"How consistently the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, implementation details, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad adjectives and unsupported self-description."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specifics, but most major claims remain generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mixes general claims with some concrete examples of work or outcomes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter regularly backs claims with specific projects, systems, methods, or results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is consistently evidence-rich, making nearly every important claim concrete and credible."}]},{"name":"Security engagement","description":"How much additional security involvement the letter shows beyond ordinary software-engineering duties, such as competitions or certifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no extracurricular or credential-based evidence of security engagement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions casual security interest with limited substance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides one meaningful outside signal, such as recurring CTF participation or a foundational certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong outside engagement through serious competition results or an advanced practical certification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter combines multiple strong outside signals, such as high-level CTF involvement and respected hands-on security credentials, in a way that materially strengthens the profile."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"The extent to which the letter shows ownership of code used by others through open-source maintenance or meaningful upstream contribution.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of open-source involvement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions only minor or occasional contributions with little sense of responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows recurring contributions or patches to projects the applicant uses."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear stewardship, such as maintaining a library or regularly contributing to tools with external users."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates substantial open-source ownership, including releases, reviews, community interaction, and responsibility for software used beyond the applicant's immediate team."}]},{"name":"Independent initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows that the applicant pursues substantive engineering work outside assigned job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no example of independent technical work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small side project or hobby build with limited complexity or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows consistent initiative through side projects that keep skills active or broaden the stack."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes an ambitious personal build that tackles nontrivial systems or infrastructure concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates exceptional initiative through sustained, technically demanding independent projects that approach production-grade systems complexity."}]}]}
